purpose.text: Organisational units. A department can sit under a parent department.

recordMeaning.text: One row is one organisational unit with a unique name, a cost centre code and optionally the department it reports to.

meaning.text: Department number, generated by the database starting at 1.
Name of the department; no two departments can share a name (compared without regard to upper or lower case).
The department this department sits under; empty for a top-level department.
Cost centre code the department's costs are booked to, always CC followed by four digits.

relationships.meaning: A department can sit under one parent department; top-level departments have no parent.
A department can have many sub-departments; a department with sub-departments cannot be deleted.
A department can have many employees, and every employee belongs to exactly one department; a department with employees cannot be deleted.

constraints.name: FK_Departments_Parent
constraints.definition: REFERENCES hr.Departments (DepartmentId) ON DELETE NO_ACTION ON UPDATE NO_ACTION

businessRules.text: Every department has a unique name and a cost centre code made of CC and four digits.
A parent department must be an existing department, and a department cannot be deleted while sub-departments or employees refer to it.
Departments form a single tree under one top-level unit, and each department appears to have its own cost centre; neither is enforced by the database.
